audit: independent static audit of final manual_book_browser.cjs delta

changed_behavior.change: Scene milestone verification is controlled by nativeFrame(..., checkSceneMilestones=true). Scene-mode calls retain the default exact milestone counter/heading/group checks; lesson-context result calls explicitly pass false, assert lesson route and visible lesson workspace, then record lesson_context_native. This scopes scene milestones away from the distinct course lesson workspace. The source-scene traversal still invokes the default checks for scene-mode frames and retains complete milestone step-set assertions.

New frameWhenRendered waits for exact expected decoded pixel values and every expected grid level, with equal array lengths and exact element equality, for at most 5000 ms; on success it calls the existing strict frame() assertion. It is used only after audio play/seek timeline transitions. No pixel, grid, or timing tolerance is introduced.

preservation.native_source_pins: unchanged source16 originalScene ordered step IDs and per-step output_sha256/input_sha256 checks; qualified chunk SHA checks remain.
preservation.midi: Final-only diff does not change MIDI tuple, event, truncation, or gate oracles.
preservation.pixels_and_grid: The original frame assertion remains byte-for-byte unchanged; exact decoded intensity plane and grid equality remain. This is not an independent RGBA-channel check.
preservation.scene_groups: The existing scene traversal, canonical-owner/alias milestone source rules, and coverage set equality are unchanged; only lesson-context workspace calls skip the scene-mode counter assertion.

external_evidence.race_context: Parent reports the focused audio-seek RED sampled pixel value 251 while expected was 119, then exact pixels matched after approximately 100 ms. This audit did not rerun or independently verify that observation.
external_evidence.live_run: Parent identifies the full run as live Node PID 13205/session 83377; not inspected or rerun.

decision: Static diff supports the stated narrow scope. No native/MIDI/frame/grid assertion or tolerance was weakened. Await live full-run result separately; this audit is not a test pass.
